welcome.title: Welcome to Vellum
welcome.body: Your own personal intelligence is just a step away.

privacyScreen.title: Before You Start
privacyScreen.body: Choose your privacy preferences. You can update these anytime in the Settings.

hostingScreen.title: Hosting
hostingScreen.body: Choose where you want your assistant to live.

apiKeyScreen.title: Connect a Model Provider
apiKeyScreen.body: Choose the model provider your assistant should use.
apiKeyScreen.modelsHelp: Comma-separated model identifiers exposed by your endpoint.

hatchingScreen.localFallbackPitch: Get started today with a local assistant
hatchingScreen.wakingBody: Hang tight, your assistant will have a few questions for you once it's up.

addRemoteOriginDialog.title: Add a Remote Assistant
addRemoteOriginDialog.body: Paste the https link your assistant’s pairing page gave you.

connectAssistantDialog.importedBody: This pairing is access-only: its access expires and cannot renew itself. Re-run vellum pair on the assistant’s machine and import the new bundle when it expires.
connectAssistantDialog.title: Connect a Remote Assistant
connectAssistantDialog.instruction: On the assistant’s machine, run vellum pair --url https://... and paste the bundle here.

connectRecoveryDialog.repairBody: Repairing re-provisions this assistant’s authentication token. Any other devices or browser sessions connected to it will be signed out and need to reconnect.
connectRecoveryDialog.authFailedBody: The authentication token for {name} is missing or can no longer be refreshed, so this assistant can’t be connected. You can repair it, retire it, or pick a different assistant.

consentControls.diagnosticsHelp: Send crash reports, conversation traces, and session replay data

onboardingAutocomplete.freeTextHint: Type anything and press ↵ to add your own

googleCalendar.authorizationFailed: Failed to start Google Calendar authorization.
